briefdescription.para: Enables the deprecated definitions of the µTest++ Testing Framework.

detaileddescription.para: This option has no value, only its definition matters.

Without it, the deprecated definitions (the old names of the functions, the classes, and the members, the overloaded operators, the user-defined literals, the type wrappers, and the deprecated overloads and constructors) are neither declared nor defined, so the applications that still use them fail to compile.
With it, they are available, but marked [[deprecated]], so the compiler reports their use; the applications that build with -Werror fail until the deprecated definitions are replaced.
The macro must be defined for the library sources too, otherwise the link of an application that uses the non-inline deprecated members fails with undefined references.
This is the main configuration option of this library; it has no value, only its definition matters.

Without it, micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus.h declares nothing and the library sources compile to nothing. If it is defined on the compiler command line for the application, but not for the library sources, the link fails with undefined references.

briefdescription.para: Enables the trace messages of the µTest++ constructors and destructors.

detaileddescription.para: Displays trace messages in the constructors and destructors of the µTest++ Testing Framework, through trace::printf(), which writes them only when MICRO_OS_PLUS_DIAG_TRACE_ENABLED is also defined.

briefdescription.para: Enables the trace messages of the µTest++ member functions.

detaileddescription.para: Displays trace messages in the member functions of the µTest++ Testing Framework, through trace::printf(), which writes them only when MICRO_OS_PLUS_DIAG_TRACE_ENABLED is also defined.

briefdescription.para: The macros that enable and configure the framework.

detaileddescription.para:
Where to define them
The application defines the macros; neither the library nor its CMake, meson, and xPack build files define them (the defaultDefine entries in xcdl-package.jsonc are informative only).
The application and the library sources must be compiled with the same macros, otherwise the link fails. The simplest way is a header named micro-os-plus/micro-test-plus-defines.h (or micro-os-plus/project-config.h) in the include path of the build: every µTest++ header includes it, if present, before its own definitions.
Guard each definition, so that the macro can also be given on the compiler command line:
A macro given only on the compiler command line (for example -DMICRO_OS_PLUS_MICRO_TEST_PLUS_ENABLED) must be given for the whole build, for both the application and the library sources.
